tagline: Gold market research and analysis with risk-aware decision support.
summary: Gold market research and analysis project with market context, technical inputs and risk-aware decision support.
statusNote: LSI Gold Digger is being built. No release has been published.

audiences.name: People researching the gold market
audiences.description: Anyone who wants structured market context and technical inputs to inform their own decisions.

capabilities.name: Macro-regime view
capabilities.description: A summary of the wider economic conditions that tend to influence gold.

capabilities.name: Daily bias
capabilities.description: A stated directional lean for the day, with the inputs behind it.

capabilities.name: Market structure
capabilities.description: Trend, swing highs and lows, and where structure has changed.

capabilities.name: Liquidity
capabilities.description: Price areas where resting orders are likely to cluster.

capabilities.name: Regression
capabilities.description: A regression view of where price sits relative to its recent trend.

capabilities.name: Double Bollinger Bands
capabilities.description: Two sets of Bollinger Bands used together to describe momentum and range.

capabilities.name: XM connectivity and trade execution
capabilities.description: Not implemented and not approved. It will only be shown as available if it is built and approved by LSI.

requirements.label: Account
requirements.detail: Not confirmed yet. No trading account connection is offered.

requirements.label: Data
requirements.detail: Data sources, timestamps and refresh intervals will be documented before release.

requirements.label: Connectivity
requirements.detail: An internet connection for market data.

gettingStarted: There is nothing to install or open yet. Setup steps will be published with the first release.
limitations: No release exists, so nothing described on this page can be used yet.
Analysis can be wrong, late or based on incomplete data.
The tool does not provide financial advice.

notice.title: Market outcomes are uncertain
notice.body: LSI Gold Digger is a research and analysis tool. Its analysis does not guarantee returns, and past behaviour of a market does not predict its future. You are responsible for your own decisions.
